multilingual.paragraphs: Right-to-left is decided in the architecture at the start, instead of being added at the end by flipping the layout. Every component, layout and interaction is built and checked in both directions. Arabic is adapted, not translated: navigation, alignment and reading order are reconsidered for an Arabic reader.

leading.value: Arabic headings get more room than Latin ones, so dots and tall letters never collide.

tracking.value: Never added to Arabic. Spacing breaks the joins between letters.

direction.value: Arrows, lines and order follow the reading direction, not the edge of the screen.

boundaries.intro: Five things we turn down, so you know before you ask:

items.1: Fixed deadlines set before the scope is known
items.2: Systems we could not stand behind technically
items.5: Building before the problem is mapped

boundaries.title: What we will not do.

closing.description: Describe what you are building in a few lines. You get a direct technical answer on scope, cost and fit.
closing.title: If this is how you want it built,

constraints.paragraphs: Every project starts by deciding what will not be built: the features out of scope and the use cases excluded. Your proposal states that scope, so you can check the build against it. A system designed for everyone serves no one well. Fewer, deliberate features are faster to build, test and change.
constraints.title: Constraints are a design tool.

1.altruvex: Understand the problem users are actually trying to solve
1.common: Build the features users asked for

2.altruvex: Define architectural constraints before opening the editor

3.altruvex: Launch is when the system starts working - not when fixes start
3.common: We will fix it after launch

data.description: Before UI, before features, before brand - we map what the system needs to know. A weak data model cannot be rescued by clean code on top of it.

handoff.description: Code written for one person is fragile. Every commit assumes someone else will read and extend it six months from now.
handoff.title: Write for the next engineer

maintenance.description: A system that needs constant attention is not finished. We build for long stretches of stability where nothing breaks and nothing drifts.
maintenance.title: Keep intervention cheap

scale.description: Few projects will reach it, but growth assumptions change every architectural decision made today.
scale.title: Design for ten times the load

hero.description: The order Altruvex makes technical decisions in: data first, then architecture, then features, then the page. Each layer is settled before the next is built on it.
hero.title: Our web development approach: data first, page last.

order.label: The order decisions are made in
order.note: The page is the last thing we decide, because it is the one layer that stays cheap to change.

rail.label: Laid so far
rail.note: Each chapter lays one layer. The page goes on last.
